endpoint.label: Shop endpoint
endpoint.description: Origin of the B2B-Sellers Shopware shop, e.g. https://shop.example.com — WITHOUT a /store-api suffix (the client appends /store-api and /b2b itself).

accessToken.label: Store API access key (sw-access-key)
accessToken.description: The sales-channel access key of the shop. Write-only; stored encrypted; never exposed to the browser.
